items.title: Chico Hamilton interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 30, 2000
items.q: Charlie and I, we grew up together. We came up together. And we sort of had a love-hate relationship type of thing.

ctx.x: The list of people that have been beside you is astounding. What was it like to work with Mingus?

Charlie. Charles. Well Charlie and I, we grew up together. We came up together. And we sort of had a love-hate relationship type of thing. I remember one time we were in Oakland, California, and we were with Floyd Ray’s band. And I was doing a drum solo. And man, Charlie came out, went backstage and got a hammer, and came out and started hammering the bandstand.
